title: Master Thesis - Geospatial Foundation Models for Land Cover Mapping in Africa
cardTitle:
Geospatial Foundation Models
for Land Cover Mapping
description: For my master thesis at Wageningen University, I am researching the performance of the Geospatial Foundation Model Galileo on Land Cover Mapping in Africa, a challenging task. I will research whether Galileo, if used with the right input modalities and hyperparameters, can beat the current state of the art models at this task.

The thesis will involve hyperparameter tuning, looking into the impact of different modalities and temporal resolutions on the land cover classification, and comparing the results with the current best models.

title: Detecting Potential Aviation Obstacles using AHN
description: During my Master, I worked with a team of students for Antea Group. Our task was to create a pipeline for automatic detection of the apex points of trees and buildings, using a combination of open source datasets including AHN and BAG. This pipeline successfully makes the detection of potential aviation obstacles around airports more robust and faster.

title: Creating Infrastructure for Graveyard Mapping
description: During my time at Movares, I was responsible for the creation of GIS infrastructure for the efficient mapping of graveyards. The created products help field workers from Movares and Kybys quickly create a graves dataset for a previously unmapped graveyard, by utilizing 360-degree images and orthomosaics created by NavVis LiDAR scanners.

The project involved detecting graves from orthomosaics, utilizing OCR on 360-degree images to assign names and dates to graves, and creating an ArcGIS Dashboard for quick human-in-the-loop validation.

title: Bachelor Thesis - Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
description: For my Bachelor Thesis at the HAS University of Applied Sciences, I created a point cloud object segmentation pipeline for the Dutch dredging company Van Oord. The pipeline creates a 2D orthomosaic from a point cloud of a dredging site, then uses the YOLO deep learning model for automatic segmentation of non-ground objects (pipes and machinery) in the ortho. Lastly, the pipeline uses the 2D objects for point classification.
This pipeline significantly sped up the point cloud cleaning process, allowing for quick processing of point clouds of dredging projects, which Van Oord creates regularly.

title: Fietsmeister - Website for cyclists to monitor road blockages
commissioner: HAS University of Applied Sciences; Philip Lobatto
description: During my Bachelor, I developed a web app called 'Fietsmeister'. This app was created to enable cyclists in the Netherlands to report road blockages, and plan their routes around these blockages in advance. The project resulted in a fully working front-end and back-end for road blockage monitoring.
